column1: @ SELECT n.value, r.repository_id, r.repository_owner_id, r.state, (SELECT s.value FROM names s WHERE s.id = r.successor), r.state_at, r.time FROM repos r JOIN names n ON n.id = r.repo ORDER BY n.value

@ SELECT n.value, e.seq, e.action, e.repository_id_before, e.repository_id_after, e.owner_id_before, e.owner_id_after, (SELECT s.value FROM names s WHERE s.id = e.successor), e.claims, e.time FROM repo_events e JOIN names n ON n.id = e.repo ORDER BY n.value, e.seq
@ SELECT n.value, c.etag, c.checked_at, c.next_check_at, c.fail_count, c.app_installed FROM repo_checks c JOIN names n ON n.id = c.repo ORDER BY n.value
@ SELECT r.log_index, n.value, r.tag, r.withdrawn, r.withdrawn_at FROM releases r JOIN names n ON n.id = r.repo ORDER BY r.log_index
@ SELECT value FROM names WHERE kind = 2 ORDER BY value
@ SELECT release, via, claims, time FROM provenance ORDER BY release, via
